changes: City list checked against the web: one guide gives 16 cities in Romania, 11 in Bulgaria and 3 in Türkiye (30 in total), which matches the dataset's list exactly. The wiki's Road to the Black Sea page lists Bacău, Brașov, București, Cluj-Napoca, Constanța, Craiova, Mangalia and Reșița among the Romanian cities. No SCS rework of Romania, Bulgaria or Türkiye turned up through update 1.61 (Sep 2026) or the Iceland DLC. No city added or removed.

Radio-only candidates not added: Arad, Baia Mare, Oradea, Piatra Neamț and Sibiu (RO), and Yambol/Ямбол (BG). No search found evidence that any of them is in vanilla; the Romanian names only turned up in ProMods and fan Romania maps. The wiki's list of Bulgarian scenery villages (Debelt, German, Kostinbrod, Montana, Petrohan, Pomorie, Razgrad, Ruzhintsi, Sredets, Staro Oryahovo, Zlatitsa, Zlatna Panega) does not include Yambol. No listed_as_village entries to remove.

Galați-Constanța: set ferry=true and conf high. The route needs the in-game BAC river ferry Brăila-Smârdan (SCS blog post of 2019-11-06 on the Brăila ferry; the wiki calls it the only ferry crossing in Romania, with no bridge to Smârdan). The earlier version had ferry=false even though its note described the ferry.
Sofia-Niš: conf low->medium, km 155->160, road text now via Kalotina-Gradina. The wiki's border crossing list names Gradina-Kalotina as a West Balkans crossing.
Craiova-Niš: conf low->medium. The wiki lists Vrshka Chuka-Vrashka Chuka (BG-RS) as a West Balkans crossing, which confirms the Vidin-Kula-Zaječar route rather than the Iron Gates.
Timișoara-Beograd: conf low->medium. The wiki lists Vatin-Moravița on R10/DN59 as a West Balkans crossing.
Pernik-Skopje: conf low->medium, km 190->200, road text via Radomir and Kyustendil. The wiki lists Deve Bair-Gyueshevo as a West Balkans crossing.
Pernik-Thessaloniki: conf low->medium, km 285->260. SCS blog posts on the Greece border crossings (Jul/Aug 2024) describe Kulata-Promachonas as a Greece DLC crossing.

Edirne-Kavala: re-routed via the confirmed İpsala-Kipoi crossing (the SCS blog calls it the largest Greece DLC crossing; the wiki lists it on A2/D110), km 300->310, conf stays low. No search result mentioned a Pazarkule-Kastanies crossing. The Greece DLC city list (Argostoli, Athens, Chania, Chios, Heraklion, Ioannina, Kalamata, Kavala, Lamia, Larissa, Mytilene, Patras, Rhodes, Thessaloniki, Trikala) confirms Kavala as the nearest Greek city; Alexandroupoli and Komotini are not cities.
Added cross-border edge Tekirdağ-Kavala via D110 (Malkara, Keşan) and İpsala-Kipoi, 330 km, conf medium. The crossing sits on D110, which starts at Tekirdağ.

Added cross-border edge Plovdiv-Kavala via Haskovo, Kardzhali and the Makaza-Nymfaia crossing, 290 km, conf low. The SCS blog and the wiki list Makaza as a BG-GR crossing in the Greece DLC; the Bulgarian approach road is not verified.

Kept unchanged because the web neither confirmed nor disproved them: Hunedoara-Brașov (via Sibiu), Hunedoara-Pitești (Olt valley), Craiova-București (via Alexandria) and Karlovo-Veliko Tarnovo (Shipka pass). Searches found no in-game village evidence for Sibiu, Făgăraș, Râmnicu Vâlcea, Alexandria, Caracal, Kazanlak or Gabrovo.
Graph check: all 30 cities are connected; 61 edges, 3 of them new or rerouted Greek links.
